review:
A tiny Christmas 3x3 with five lines and a pick-a-present bonus. Three bonus symbols across the first three reels open it.

Five gifts appear and you choose one. The other four open first so you can see what you might have had, then yours reveals the real multiplier – up to 499x your bet. Medium volatility, a 559x cap and 96.07% RTP. Quick, simple, festive.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
